about_the_game:
Toxic is a post-apocalyptic action RPG where scavengers, outlaws, and mutants fight for survival across a scorched and poisoned world. Drawing heavy inspiration from classic ARPGs and the brutal vehicular chaos of combat driver games, this is a fast-paced, loot-heavy, open-world experience where you'll alternate between brutal shootouts and high-octane vehicular carnage.

Explore a shattered Earth where corrupted beasts, zombies and raiders.  Customize your character, build and upgrade deadly vehicles, and carve a name into the wasteland one kill at a time.

Toxic takes a different approach to character design.  Here, the player can customize your character right from the start.  Change everything about it, the colors, the body shape, and even the clothing they will be wearing right away!  Add extra bits to it for armor as the game progresses, but always have your character looking as tough as you want!

The Collapse came from the sky

A generation ago, the world was bathed in a chemical rain that burned away the cities, choked the oceans, and awakened something unnatural deep in the earth. Civilization crumbled in months. What remains is the Deadlands — a sprawling desert filled with radioactive storms, deranged warlords, mutated humans and monstrous alien creatures.

As one drifting through the Deadlands, whether you seek answers, or not, you'll need to fight through blood-soaked ruins of cities once been, forge uneasy alliances, and uncover the truth behind the goo, a green jelly-like substance which has been all but replaced the natural waters of the planet.  It kind of tastes like watermelon actually.

Embrace the goo, weaponize it, or push it aside.  The goo is here to stay, but are you?

short_description: Toxic is a savage, multiplayer, loot-driven ARPG set in the blistering aftermath of the end times. Battle through toxic wastelands, mutated jungles, driving back hordes of zombies, mutants and ruthless raider clans — on foot and behind the wheel of heavily-armed war machines.
